text:
Alex K: FYI presales question from BankBrasil — they want a short POC and have two hard asks: data for Brazilian customers must stay in Brazil (sa-east1) by default, but they also have a Canadian office and want failover to Canada (northamerica-northeast1). They also asked about BYOK (customer-managed keys) that live in BR region. Can we confirm whether we can do tenant-pin + regional KMS BYOK, and how routing/costs look?
Maria S: thanks — is this for Hosted API or Dedicated? and do they expect traffic to originate from both countries? :eyes:
Alex K: primary traffic from BR, occasional from CA. Customer leaning towards Dedicated for predictable throughput during POC (capacity ~10 req/s, 50k tokens/day). They sent a security questionnaire asking for sub-processor list for both regions and if we store any logs outside pinned region. Also: will cross-region failover double egress billing?
Samir R: short answers: tenant-pin to region is doable for Dedicated/private, Hosted has region preferences but not strict pinning unless we do tenant routing. BYOK per-region is supported but requires KMS key in the target region and contract/byok addendum. Cross-region egress: network egress and cloud provider inter-region charges will apply; our token billing stays per-request but any cross-region network fees are extra. For POC costing, dedicated reserved nodes reduce per-token infra cost vs burst on hosted.
Samir R: sample routing policy we usually propose for this pattern (replace region names as needed):
```json
{
  "routing": "prefer_region",
  "preferred_regions": ["sa-east1"],
  "failover": ["northamerica-northeast1"],
  "fallback_policy": "nearest_available",
  "kms_policy": {"byok_required": true, "preferred_key_regions": ["sa-east1"]}
}
```
Samir R: with that policy, requests from BR stick to sa-east1; if capacity unavailable we failover to CA. Note: when we failover to CA, network egress may be charged by the cloud and we surface that as a separate line in the quote.
Lee P: security notes: BYOK in BR requires the customer's key in the same region and an HSM-backed KMS is recommended for financials. We will need a short addendum for key handling + key rotation responsibilities. Sub-processor list: we can provide region-filtered list; edge cache + CDN providers may be involved for routing telemetry. I'll attach the canonical subproc doc link in the follow-up. @Alex K please collect the questionnaire questions that are BYOK-specific.
Maria S: for pricing: presales rule of thumb — estimate (a) dedicated baseline for the POC (3-month min) and (b) ad-hoc egress buffer. Samir, can you ballpark infra delta if they want strict tenant-pin vs soft-prefer?
Samir R: strict tenant-pin (pin to a single AZ/region) increases operational overhead and could increase cost ~10-20% vs soft-prefer because we reserve capacity and can’t autoscale across regions. Soft-prefer with failover saves cost but has the cross-region egress risk. Exact numbers depend on instance type; I can draft a 3-month quote table.
presales-bot: checklist created: POC checklist #4821 — confirm: contract addendum for BYOK, sub-processor per-region doc, dedicated sizing, POC timeline, security Q answers, pricing estimate. Link: https://redwood.internal/presales/4821
infra-oncall: quick way to sanity-check endpoints:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFIRE" https://inference.sa-east1.redwood.ai/health
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFIRE" https://inference.northamerica-northeast1.redwood.ai/health
```
infra-oncall: to simulate failover locally you can POST a routing override to our staging router:
```json
{ "override": {"routing": "force_failover", "target_region": "northamerica-northeast1"} }
```
Alex K: perfect, thanks all. Two asks from my side: 1) single-page pricing + expected extra egress estimate for BR->CA failover, and 2) a short note on contract delta for BYOK tenant-pin we can share with legal. Can someone own those? :thumbsup:
Maria S: I’ll own the pricing one, will include the soft vs strict pin delta and a conservative egress buffer.
Lee P: I’ll draft the BYOK addendum note and the sub-processor excerpt for BR/CA.
Samir R: I’ll put together the infra delta and the sample instance sizing for 10 req/s. Expect drafts by EOD tomorrow.
Alex K: awesome — scheduling a quick handoff call with the customer on Thurs 10:30 BR time. I’ll drop calendar invite once I have the pricing one-pager. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
